conflicts.note: U19 Süper Lig is the Süper Lig clubs' youth competition: entry is compulsory for the 18 senior clubs, fixtures mirror the senior list, no promotion or relegation. Keep it at level 99 and closed both ways; the field changes only when a senior club goes up or down.

notes: Süper Lig: 18 clubs since 2025-26, 34 rounds, bottom three relegated directly. The TFF 1. Lig (level 2, not in our rows) has 20 clubs and promotes 3: champion and runner-up directly, 3rd-7th into a play-off (3rd straight to the final, 4th-7th single games at the higher seed, two legs in the semi-finals, neutral final); it relegates four to the 2. Lig. Because level 2 is not a row, TR1 carries closed_down=true and no boundary object exists for 1-2. U19: 34 matches, top eight into the Türkiye Finalleri, U19 squad limits are 16-19 with at most five 20-21-year-olds and one foreigner.
